meaning:
γῆρας, Attic, genitive (-αος) -ως, dative ᾳ; Ion. and κοινή, -εος (-ους), dative -ει, τό,
[in LXX for שֵׂיבָה, etc. ;]
old age: ἐν γήρει, Luk.1:36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
